questions.question: Should forward testing and backward testing simulate trades only, or should the application send real orders?
questions.recommendedChoice: Simulation only; never send real orders
questions.answer: Simulation only; never send real orders

options.label: Simulation only; never send real orders
options.description: Record simulated entries, stops, targets, and results without broker connectivity.

options.label: Include real order execution
options.description: Add broker integration and live order placement, which requires separate risk and credential requirements.

questions.rationale: Forward testing commonly means paper trading, but the boundary between simulation and real execution must be explicit.

questions.question: Confirm the intended 5 EMA rule: the first candle and following opposite-color candle both remain strictly on the same side of the EMA (their full wick ranges do not touch/cross it); for a short setup above EMA, enter on an intrabar break below the second candle's low and place the stop at its high; reverse those rules for a long setup below EMA. Is that correct?
questions.recommendedChoice: Yes: strict wick non-touch; opposite-color second candle on the same EMA side; enter on intrabar break of its extreme; stop at its opposite extreme
questions.answer: Yes: strict wick non-touch; opposite-color second candle on the same EMA side; enter on intrabar break of its extreme; stop at its opposite extreme

options.label: Yes: strict wick non-touch; opposite-color second candle on the same EMA side; enter on intrabar break of its extreme; stop at its opposite extreme
options.description: Use the complete rule stated in the question for both long and short setups.

options.label: Require candle-close confirmation beyond the second candle's extreme
options.description: Wait until a bar closes through the trigger level before recording an entry.

options.label: Use a different interpretation
options.description: Specify the candle, EMA-touch, or entry rules you intend.

questions.rationale: The phrases 'without touching' and 'on break' can materially change backtest outcomes; the proposed interpretation treats any wick contact as a touch and triggers intrabar.

questions.question: How should the minimum 1:3 risk/reward requirement be applied?
questions.recommendedChoice: Set the profit target at 3R from entry; reject setups whose modeled reward is below 3R
questions.answer: Set the profit target at 3R from entry; reject setups whose modeled reward is below 3R

options.label: Set the profit target at 3R from entry; reject setups whose modeled reward is below 3R
options.description: Use a fixed 3R target and do not enter a setup that cannot meet the minimum.

options.label: Require at least 3R but allow a farther target
options.description: Treat 3R as a floor and allow a configurable target above it.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify how target price and minimum reward/risk should be calculated.

questions.rationale: A stop at the setup candle's opposite extreme determines risk, but the requested wording does not specify a profit-target policy.
